text: Zebulon Struble, Army ROTC, Administrative Coordinator- This government shutdown has little effect on the ROTC program because the Department of Defense and Department of the Army are considered essential personnel at this time and are still being paid. The only effect it is having is that some of the agencies we might deal with in our day to day operations may have been affected and thus may slow down our operations slightly. -Jacob Brewster, Air Force - couldn’t go on the record but he could confirm that ROTC members were still receiving their monthly stipend during the shutdown.
